pages.text: $(thing)Animal Husbandry$() makes farm animals feel alive. Each has hunger, cleanliness, happiness, health and inherited traits. Care changes what you get.

pages.title: Farm Ledger
pages.text: Tracks hunger, cleanliness, growth, yield, fertility and happiness. The $(item)Farm Magnifying Glass$() inspects one animal: sickness, cooldowns, wool and milk.

pages.title: Grooming
pages.text: Brush animals to raise happiness. Feeding Troughs hold feed, Brushing Posts help with grooming, and sick animals need Animal Medicine. A Fertility Potion readies a pair to mate.

Traits come from genes. A Glutton grows fast. A Truffle Snout finds more truffles. A Heavyweight drops double meat and leather. Look at an animal in the ledger to see what it has.$(br2)The pack runs Animal Husbandry 0.4.2, so there are no rabbit genetics or Angora armor.

pages.title: Eggs and Cheese
pages.text: Chicken Nests hold eggs. Milk in a cauldron becomes cheese blocks and slices. Pigs with the right trait dig up truffles.

Other animal mods: $(bold)Critters and Companions$() adds small creatures like red pandas, ferrets, koi and dragonflies. Its otter, Dumbo Octopus and Sea Bunny spawns are off. $(bold)Naturalist$() adds bears, deer, elephants, lions and more. Nine of its sea animals are off; see $(l:ocean/sea_life)Sea Life$(/l).

Create tie-ins: Roosts and Fishing Nets from $(l:food/integrated_farming)Integrated Farming$(/l) handle poultry on contraptions, and Ratatouille's Spreader breeds animals. Bees: $(l:food/bees)Productive Bees$(/l).
